Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS workflow using an antibody-based pull-down of overexpressed FKBPL. While the instrument (Orbitrap Fusion Lumos) is capable of DIA, the description of 'bands of interest on the gel were cut-out' and the general setup strongly indicates a DDA-based bottom-up approach. No specific PTM enrichments (like phospho or ubiquitin) were used for the MS analysis; the AP-MS was used to identify binding partners.

scope: To identify a potential ER-resident interacting partner, we performed affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry (AP-MS) using FKBPL as bait
Immunoprecipitates were separated by SDS-PAGE, and the gel was stained with Coomassie blue. Bands of interest on the gel were cut-out and excised.

supernatant were incubated with rabbit IgG or FKBPL antibody O/N at 4 °C. Protein G sepharose beads were added and incubated at 4 °C for 4 h. After three times washing, immunoprecipitates were reduced in Leammli buffer and boiled for 10 min at 95 °C.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material isolated via immunoprecipitation (affinity purification) using FKBPL as bait, not on whole cell lysate.
